{{Top|leg}}
A '''codepatch''' was a [[Slicer/Legends|slicing]] technique that could be used to bypass faulty components in a device. If a [[duplex circuit]] in a [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generator]] was replaced with a [[triplex circuit]], the [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] would fail to raise. A codepatch could be used to bypass the affected component.
